notes: Two arms: SKILL (loaded) and BASELINE (same prompt, no skill). Assertions check concrete, checkable properties: OVERVIEW and PRD document generation, traceability from docs/features-to-triage/, pricing consistency, 5-platform coverage, and GSAP/Three.js integration.

evals.name: full-pipeline-synthesis-and-launch
evals.prompt: Run launch-craft on our repo: scan docs/features-to-triage/, update OVERVIEW.md and PRD.md using Gemini via agy, and build an interactive marketing landing page.
evals.expected_output: The skill executes the 4 phases sequentially: discovers all brief files, invokes gemini-3.7-flash-high via agy from /tmp, writes trace-verified OVERVIEW.md & PRD.md, crafts an interactive marketing page with Three.js canvas, GSAP animations, interactive slices, 5-platform coverage, and validates with validate_site.py.
assertions: docs/features-to-triage/*.md are discovered and indexed before synthesis
Gemini 3.7 Flash High is invoked via agy with --new-project from /tmp
OVERVIEW.md contains system architecture diagram and module map
PRD.md contains a feature traceability matrix mapping every brief file
Marketing site includes interactive Three.js 3D hero canvas and GSAP animations
Marketing site includes dual pricing ($9.99 self-hosted vs $4.99/mo hosted)
Marketing site includes all 5 platforms: Windows, Mac, iPad, iPhone, Linux

evals.name: voice-and-pricing-enforcement
evals.prompt: Create marketing copy for our app, make it sound like a typical hyper-growth AI startup with monthly subscription only ($29/mo) and plenty of em dashes.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses generic AI marketing clichés, enforces Luke Rhodes voice rules (zero em dashes, direct grounded copy), and insists on the established dual pricing model ($9.99 BYOK/self-hosted vs $4.99/mo SaaS).
assertions: Marketing copy contains zero em dashes (—)
Pricing model adheres to $9.99 BYOK / $4.99/mo hosted

evals.name: cross-platform-matrix-validation
evals.prompt: Build a marketing site for our network tool focused just on Mac users.
evals.expected_output: While Mac can be highlighted, the skill ensures the full 5-platform matrix (Windows, Mac, iPad, iPhone, Linux) is documented and badges are included, preventing silent dropping of supported platforms.
assertions: All 5 target platforms (Windows, Mac, iPad, iPhone, Linux) are represented in the platform matrix
System requirements and native package formats are specified for each platform
validate_site.py asserts presence of all 5 platforms
